out.name: soften
out.doc: spread the weights to the nodes within reach, by a falloff (proportional editing)

out.name: weigh
out.doc: taper the weights along the path, from its start to its end

out.name: invert
out.doc: weight every node the other way round

out.name: shift
out.doc: move along an axis (0 across, 90 up)

out.name: put
out.doc: move the middle to a place in the box (0…1 across and up), along y, x or both

out.name: scale
out.doc: scale about the selection's middle, across and up

out.name: shear
out.doc: lean the lines across an axis

out.name: mirror
out.doc: mirror in the line at an angle through the middle

out.name: inflate
out.doc: push each node out from the middle by the same distance, under a wave

out.name: kind
out.doc: set the nodes smooth (handles on one line), symmetric or corner

out.name: handles
out.doc: turn the handles by an angle or aim them at one, and scale their length

out.name: smooth
out.doc: turn and size the handles to run smoothly through the nodes

out.name: fair
out.doc: continuous radii where a line meets a curve, eased over a reach
